mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 57 degrees outside near Verona City Hall. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight, and if you are still up at 3:25 AM, you can catch the International Space Station moving from the direction of Mount Horeb toward Madison, passing high overhead.
Regarding city business, we have no new important emails, but the police department has released their weekly recap of calls for service from August 17 through August 24.

It is a great time to be out in Verona! Today, you have your pick of trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the town really picks up with the Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
Looking at the weekly police report, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on August 19 at North Main Street and Bering Drive, where two drivers were cited for various traffic violations.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The store is currently closed, but you can head over when they open at 10 AM to get your fix.
